# dino-mcp — MCP Server with Interactive Dinosaur Dashboard

> MCP Apps-enabled server written in Go. Tools for dinosaur facts, Q&A, and an interactive HTML dashboard.

## Quick Links

- https://modelcontextprotocol.io — MCP Specification
- https://apps.extensions.modelcontextprotocol.io — MCP Apps API
- https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk — Go MCP SDK
- https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin — HTTP framework

## Project Files

### Core
- cmd/dino-mcp/main.go — CLI entry point (stdio/http subcommands)
- internal/server/server.go — Composition root: New(), transports, Gin routes, CORS
- internal/tools/ — Tool handlers (think.go → dino_think, ask.go → dino_ask, dashboard.go → dino_dashboard)
- internal/resources/ — Resource handlers (dashboard.go → ui://dino-dashboard/mcp-app.html + embedded HTML)

### UI Source
- ui/src/mcp-app.ts — App class with ext-apps SDK
- ui/vite.config.ts — Vite + singlefile plugin
- ui/package.json — Node.js dependencies

### Build
- Makefile — All build/run/test targets
- go.mod — Go module definition

### Docs
- AGENTS.md — AI coding instructions
- SYSTEM.md — Architecture deep-dive
- MEMORY.md — Decision log
- SKILL.md — Development skills
- PLAN.md — Roadmap
- DESIGN.md — Design decisions
- docs/ — Diátaxis documentation
- docs/adr/ — Architecture Decision Records

## Key Concepts

- **Tools**: dino_think (random fact), dino_ask (Q&A), dino_dashboard (MCP App)
- **Resources**: ui://dino-dashboard/mcp-app.html with MIME type text/html;profile=mcp-app
- **Transports**: stdio (Claude Desktop) and Streamable HTTP (browser/Inspector)
- **MCP Apps**: HTML UI via @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps SDK over postMessage
- **Standalone**: /dashboard page + /api/dinosaurs JSON for browser fallback

## Dependencies
- Go 1.25+, github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.6.1, github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.12.0
- @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps (build-time for UI bundling)
- cloudflared (dev-time for tunnel)

## Architecture

Server uses Gin router with CORS middleware wrapping MCP SDK's StreamableHTTPHandler. Tools registered via mcp.AddTool(). UI embedded via //go:embed and served as MCP resource. Standalone access at /dashboard with REST fallback at /api/dinosaurs.
